The Moradabad Hurricane: wreck-based airframe recovered by the IAF from a Moradabad display in 2021 and stored dismantled in a hangar at the museum; research by warbirds.in (June 2022) identifies it as most likely BN225 of 6 Sqn IAF, crash-landed 1943. Not on public display as of the last report.
